title: Finite measures with equal integrals of smooth test functions supported in U agree on U
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝⁿ be open, and let μ, ν be finite Borel measures on ℝⁿ. Suppose ∫ b dμ = ∫ b dν for every b : ℝⁿ → ℝ that is C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)), has compact support and satisfies tsupport b ⊆ U. Then the restrictions agree: μ⌞U = ν⌞U (μ.restrict U = ν.restrict U).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid n)) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid n)), IsOpen U → IsFiniteMeasure μ → IsFiniteMeasure ν → (∀ b : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) b → HasCompactSupport b → tsupport b ⊆ U → ∫ y, b y ∂μ = ∫ y, b y ∂ν) → μ.restrict U = ν.restrict U
